name: @cc/dsh-run-code-projection
description: Bounds one run_code result in the model context: on tools/post-execute a result above minBytes is replaced by a banner naming a spill file inside the session workspace plus its head and tail, so the full text stays readable with the ordinary file tools while the middle stops being re-sent every step. Errors, short results, images and already-projected content pass through untouched.
